features.title: A summary line under each finished turn
features.summary: Under each finished turn, one line says what the agent did with tools: commands run, files edited, files read and searches. When commands failed, a red count opens a list naming each failed command and how it ended (exit code, signal, or a call the tool rejected). Each part can be switched off.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the summary line under finished turns.
Boolean; count file reads and searches as well as commands and edits.
Boolean; let the failed-command count open the list of failed commands.

failureModes: A turn whose tool calls fell outside the loaded history summarises only the calls still loaded.
The summary sits under the turn, not in each "Ran commands" group header: the Host draws that header with no plugin seam.
